source.note: Captures the full Gemini six-stage round-trip for the simplest case. The Go integration test feeds an httpclient.Request{Path:'/v1beta/models/gemini-2.5-flash:generateContent', Body:<JSON below>} to InboundTransformer.TransformRequest and asserts the resulting llm.Request has Model='gemini-2.5-flash', MaxTokens=1024, one user message 'Hello, Gemini!', Stream=false (path contains 'streamGenerateContent' is false). It then feeds the llm.Request to OutboundTransformer.TransformRequest and asserts outbound method=POST, Content-Type='application/json', url='https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-2.5-flash:generateContent', and that the body unmarshals to a GenerateContentRequest. The Go test then synthesizes an inline Gemini response (ResponseID='test-response-123', one candidate with role 'model', text 'This is a test response from Gemini.', FinishReason='STOP', UsageMetadata{prompt 15, candidates 25, total 40}), feeds it to OutboundTransformer.TransformResponse and asserts chatResp has id='test-response-123', object='chat.completion', model='gemini-2.5-flash', one choice with role 'assistant' and content 'This is a test response from Gemini.' and finish_reason 'stop'. Finally InboundTransformer.TransformResponse yields HTTP 200 + Content-Type 'application/json' with body unmarshaling to a GenerateContentResponse whose ResponseID='test-response-123', ModelVersion='gemini-2.5-flash', candidates[0].content.role='model'. selected_channel is null (no llm.Channel constructed by the test).

inbound_http._comment: Verbatim from TestGeminiTransformers_Integration case 'simple text message'. Path is the literal request path; Query is empty. Body is the inline JSON string from the Go test.

unified_request._comment: llm.Request asserted by the Go integration test: Model='gemini-2.5-flash' (extracted from path), MaxTokens=1024 (from generationConfig.maxOutputTokens), one user message with content 'Hello, Gemini!'. Stream is asserted false for this path; outbound direction re-derives 'gemini-2.5-flash' from the model.

outbound_http._comment: From the same integration test step 2: outboundTransformer.TransformRequest(chatReq) yields method=POST, Content-Type='application/json', url='https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-2.5-flash:generateContent'. Auth uses StaticKeyProvider('test-api-key'); the Go test does not byte-assert the auth header, so the precise header format is 'pending source snapshot'. Body unmarshals to GenerateContentRequest; only the asserted fields are reproduced here (the round-trip preserves the user message and generationConfig).
outbound_http.auth_note: pending source snapshot: precise Authorization / x-goog-api-key header format is not byte-asserted by this Go test.

upstream_http._comment: Synthesized inline Gemini response from the Go integration test (step 3). ResponseID='test-response-123', ModelVersion='gemini-2.5-flash', one candidate with role 'model', text 'This is a test response from Gemini.', FinishReason='STOP', UsageMetadata{prompt 15, candidates 25, total 40}. Serialized with status 200.

client_http._comment: Final inbound-transformed response. The Go test asserts finalHttpResp has StatusCode=200, Content-Type='application/json', body unmarshals to GenerateContentResponse with ResponseID='test-response-123', ModelVersion='gemini-2.5-flash', candidates[0].content.role='model'. The body shape mirrors the upstream Gemini response (the Gemini inbound path passes the Gemini response through).
